background: Herb Irons is the Goshen County sheriff-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Sheriff Kory Fleenor, who is serving through the current term. Official staff directories list him as a lieutenant in the sheriff's office, and the 2025-2026 county salary publication (used here for job titles only) lists him as lieutenant, jail administrator, and investigator-professional. In a Torrington Telegram candidate questionnaire published August 17, 2026, he wrote that he has lived in Goshen County his entire life, graduated from Southeast High School in 2010, and has worked at the Sheriff's Office for more than 13 years. He won the November 2026 general election after the August Republican primary.
